title: GeekSMP Resourcepack
description: Community resourcepack for the GeekSMP Minecraft server!
body:
This simple resourcepack is for the GeekSMP/CommandGeek community! If you use Respackopts, all items are configurable via the Resourcepacks menu.

### Recommended mods
- [CIT Resewn](https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn)
- [Respackopts](https://modrinth.com/mod/respackopts)

### Bugs/suggestions
To report bugs and/or suggest new textures, please use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/srnyx/geeksmp-rp/issues)!
You can also upload your own custom textures for items by creating a [GitHub Pull Request](https://github.com/srnyx/geeksmp-rp/pulls). Please make sure to follow the format of the resourcepack correctly (a maintainer will adjust if needed).

### Credits
Huge credit goes to `Milk🌌#3023` (aka MillkSheik) for putting together the original resourcepack :D
